parameters.name: sizePage
parameters.description: Items per page. Use `0` to retrieve only the count without fetching any item — faster when you only need the total.

schema.description:
Granular technical state of a payment.

* `Draft` — reserved for future use (`Status` = `Draft`)
* `Pending` — payment is in progress and will change status once completed (`Pending`)
* `Completed` — payment successfully processed (`Completed`)
* `CompletedRefunded` — payment completed but subsequently refunded (`Completed`)
* `CompletedChargedback` — payment completed with subsequent chargeback (`Completed`)
* `CancelledAgent` — payment cancelled by a member of your organisation (`Cancelled`)
* `Failed` — payment attempt unsuccessful (`Failed`)
* `ReversedRefund` — funds reversed due to an organisation-initiated refund (`Reversed`)
* `ReversedChargeback` — funds reversed due to a chargeback by the customer or their bank (`Reversed`)
schema.title: StatePayment

schema.description:
Payment method.

* `Free` — subscription is free; no payment requested
* `ExternalCheck` — payment by check
* `ExternalCash` — payment by cash
* `ExternalBank` — payment by wire transfer
* `ExternalOther` — other external payment method
* `Card` — card payment with automated renewal
* `DirectDebit` — bank account debit with automated renewal
schema.title: TypePayment
